claim: The campaign panel hotkeys (show_lists, show_gov, show_diplomacy, show_missions, show_technologies in default_keys.xml) are handled by the engine, not by Lua: the campaign root's OnShortcut(name, down) handles voice chat, move speed, escape menu, saves, labels, selection and flags only, and no UI script holds the show_* strings; from Lua the panels open through the root functions their menu buttons call, each a closure over the root's PanelManager: ToggleEntityLists (entity_lists), ShowGovernmentPopup (government_screens), ToggleDiplomacyPopup (diplomacy_panel), ShowMissionsPopup (missions), ShowTechnologies (technology), ShowBuildingBrowser (building_browser), all seen on screen in run 20261101_j9fix; ShowPrestige() errors in Huds.lua:51 without its arguments; PanelManager.CloseAllPanels left the missions panel up
notes: the campaign-start Mission Issued popup (event_message) can arrive seconds after the campaign loads: close it (campaign_modal_close.lua) after it shows, not right after the scene
